title: "Publications"
toc: true
toc-title: "Jump to"
---

```{r}
#| echo: false
#| message: false
#| warning: false
library(yaml)
library(glue)

# Find _data folder by walking up from current working directory
find_data <- function(filename) {
  path <- file.path("_data", filename)
  if (file.exists(path)) return(path)
  # try one level up
  path2 <- file.path("..", "_data", filename)
  if (file.exists(path2)) return(path2)
  stop(paste("Cannot find", filename, "- checked:", path, "and", path2))
}

pubs <- yaml::read_yaml(find_data("publications.yml"))

render_tags <- function(tags) {
  if (is.null(tags)) return("")
  spans <- paste0('<span class="dc-tag">', tags, '</span>', collapse = " ")
  paste0('<div class="dc-tags" style="margin-top:0.75rem;">', spans, '</div>')
}

render_pub <- function(p) {
  doi_html      <- if (!is.null(p$doi))      glue('<a class="dc-pub-link" href="https://doi.org/{p$doi}" target="_blank">DOI &rarr;</a>') else ""
  pdf_html      <- if (!is.null(p$pdf))      glue('<a class="dc-pub-link" href="{p$pdf}" target="_blank">&darr; PDF</a>') else ""
  abstract_html <- if (!is.null(p$abstract)) glue('<p class="dc-pub-abstract">{p$abstract}</p>') else ""
  authors_fmt   <- gsub("\\*\\*(.*?)\\*\\*", "<strong>\\1</strong>", p$authors)
  glue('
<div class="dc-pub">
  <div class="dc-pub-year">{p$year}</div>
  <div class="dc-pub-title">{p$title}</div>
  <div class="dc-pub-authors">{authors_fmt}</div>
  <div class="dc-pub-venue">{p$journal}</div>
  {abstract_html}
  {render_tags(p$tags)}
  <div class="dc-pub-links">{doi_html}{pdf_html}</div>
</div>')
}

render_section <- function(items, label, number) {
  if (is.null(items) || length(items) == 0) return(invisible(NULL))
  cat(glue('<div class="dc-section-divider"><span class="dc-section-divider-label">{number} — {label}</span><div class="dc-section-divider-line"></div></div>\n'))
  items <- items[order(sapply(items, function(p) p$year), decreasing = TRUE)]
  for (p in items) cat(render_pub(p), "\n")
}
```
